rule: Same observation may appear in multiple panels. Do not add node aggregate and its constituent edge observation to one final score. For incremental predictive value use leave-one-partner-out donor/recipient aggregates and temporal holdout. All-sector rows cannot stand in for health-specific outcomes.
Separate publication completeness from outcome quality. One shared project is one intervention cluster. API/XML reporting is not independent corroboration of an evaluation it republishes.
Agency-level and 2024 edition. No national average without matched agency coverage and defensible weights; do not count ATI publication and IATI completeness as two independent achievements.

Changing from cooperation practice to capacity changes construct. Do not add total indices and shared constituent variables. Overlap source check, correlations and sensitivity required; fragility/need is not lack of cooperation willingness.
Inspect components and years. QuODA may already reuse GPEDC/ATI. CDI total includes policy domains outside aid, so use relevant components only.
Definitions differ: ODA vs OOF, commitments vs disbursements, current vs constant prices. Mirrors are alternative access routes to same observations, not extra evidence.
Record page, evaluator, financing and coverage. Priority statements demonstrate alignment, not success; pre-completion sustainability readiness differs from post-completion persistence.
